summary: Frontend-only E2E of Super Admin → Demo Accounts new features (password reveal/copy/regenerate, industry badges + filter tabs, expanded seeds). Logged in as super admin on the public preview URL, verified new page structure, created 3 demo accounts (events/agency/generic), exercised all new testids, and cleaned up all 3 accounts. Everything requested passed; no defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoAccountsPage.js is ~1325 lines — consider splitting modals (Create/Convert/Extend/Edit/Delete) into child components for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
handleRegeneratePassword uses window.confirm instead of a shadcn AlertDialog; works but inconsistent with the rest of the UI (delete uses a proper Dialog).
List response correctly omits demo_password (only has_demo_password + industry_type exposed); password is fetched lazily on Eye/Copy click as intended.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted 3 demo accounts: e2etest_events@kora.com (E2E Events Demo), e2etest_agency@kora.com (E2E Agency Demo), e2etest_generic@kora.com (E2E Generic Demo). Cleanup verified — none of the 3 emails remain in the table.
verified_scenarios: Page loads with data-testid demo-account-industry-filter; tabs demo-industry-tab-all/events/agency/generic render with counters (Events 1, Agency 4, Generic 1, All 6). Tabs with 0 accounts (consulting) are intentionally hidden.
New table columns present: headers = [Organization, Industry, User, Password, Type, Modules, Trial, Actions].

Events demo created (200) with toast 'Demo data seeded: 8 clients · 12 ingredients · 6 recipes · 1 menus · 8 events · 8 proposals' (expanded seed confirmed); badge demo-industry-badge-{cid} = 'Events' with purple classes (border-purple-200 bg-purple-50 text-purple-700).
Password cell demo-password-cell-{cid} starts as ••••••••; Eye toggle reveals 'TestPW2026!' (fetched via GET /password on click), second click hides it; Copy button shows toast 'Password copied'.

Dropdown (⋮) shows both new items: demo-account-copy-password-{cid} ('Copy password') and demo-account-regen-password-{cid} ('Regenerate password'). Regenerate → confirm dialog accepted → toast 'New password generated and copied: DemoXCyiiXbf4' and the cell refreshed to the new password.

Agency demo: blue badge 'Agency', seed toast '8 clients · 8 projects · 8 proposals' (projects=8 confirmed). Generic demo: grey/slate badge 'Generic', seed toast '5 clients · 5 services' (services=5 confirmed).
Filter behaviour: 'Agency' tab → 4 rows, includes agency demo, excludes events demo; 'Generic' tab → 1 row (generic demo); 'All' → 6 rows.
Cleanup via UI delete modal returned cascade counts and removed all 3 accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI language for this super-admin session renders in English (labels 'Events/Agency/Generic', 'Password copied', 'New password generated and copied: ...'), so avoid asserting Spanish strings unless the language toggle is set to ES. Use https://foodops-insights.preview.emergentagent.com for automation. Pre-existing legacy accounts show 'Not stored' in the Password column because they were created before demo_password persistence — expected.
